notes.title: 👻 Beta Access!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086756/f821f0f8785b90a2f3dd799296a031ad61f402f4.png

Beta Access!


Many of you have been eagerly waiting for this moment, and to be honest, so have we. Starting now, the key distribution begins. After discussing with the team, we've decided on just one condition —


To get a key, you need to invite 4 people to our Discord server. This way, there won't be too many players in the beta, creating a sort of whitelist. Any previous invites also count!





P.S. After inviting 4+ friends, you will receive a special role. This role is not just to make it easier to find beta testers, who knows ;)




https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061430/Caspers/

notes.title: 👻 Beta test!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086756/fe8fffcb90368ecb5f4e55e7859a0126bd0d3303.png
Keys

We will soon commence the giveaway for beta testers. Do not worry; the beta will happen, albeit a little later. This delay is necessary at this stage of project development to properly prepare and explain to the community what lies ahead and to conduct the giveaway in a way that maximizes overall benefit for the project.

Approx. date: July 19-20
